Subject: Quick recap + three windows for a 30m demo

Hi Morgan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side so we’re aligned before the demo:

- Goal: show a short 30-min product demo focused on inference latency/cost tradeoffs and how Redwood would fit into Arcadia’s privacy constraints (PHI in-scope).
- Success criteria you called out: <10% uplift on throughput w/ similar latency, VPC-only deployment options, audit/log evidence for SOC2 reviewers.
- Open items we’ll cover during the demo: your expected peak seq-length, token mix, and whether you need embeddings reuse across services.

To make the demo a productive use of time can you pick 2 preferred windows plus a backup? All times below are PT.

1) Thu Aug 28 — 11:00–11:30 PT
2) Thu Aug 28 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Fri Aug 29 — 09:00–09:30 PT

If you prefer a different day, tell me and we’ll adapt. Also, please invite your Head of Engineering / infra SME for the technical Qs (Sanjay?), and your compliance reviewer if they want to join for the tail end.

Agenda (proposed, 30m):
- 5m: quick recap of goals
- 20m: product demo + one sample inference run with your sample topology
- 5m: next steps / mutual action plan

I’ve attached a short discovery summary and an "asks" spreadsheet with items we’ll need before the technical deep dive (token distribution, current deployment topology, any redline constraints). Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, intel-ask.xlsx

Thanks — if you pick the slot I’ll send the calendar invite.

Best,
David Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com
